objective: Repetir exclusivamente en READ_ONLY el post-audit fisico de Gate12I R2 corrigiendo la consulta que podia fallar al referenciar PersonaID si la columna no existe. Determinar si la migracion dejo columna, FK o indice parcial, y confirmar integridad de FKs hijas. No ejecutar migracion, no modificar archivos, no tocar secrets ni Produccion.

queries.name: identity_guard
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS db_user, ORIGINAL_LOGIN() AS original_login;

queries.name: target_objects_state
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(o.object_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'), OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona')) ORDER BY o.name;

queries.name: persona_column_state
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name, c.max_length, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND c.name=N'PersonaID';

queries.name: persona_fk_state
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name, OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema, OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table, OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema, OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table, fk.is_disabled, fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND fk.name=N'FK_CavaSocios_Socios_GobiernoPersona';

queries.name: persona_index_state
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name, i.has_filter, i.filter_definition, i.is_disabled FROM sys.indexes i WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') AND i.name=N'IX_CavaSocios_Socios_PersonaID';

queries.name: socios_population_state
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS socios_rows FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios;

queries.name: child_fk_state
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name, OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table, fk.is_disabled, fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios') ORDER BY fk.name;

queries.name: persona_pk_state
queries.sql: SELECT kc.name AS pk_name, c.name AS column_name, TYPE_NAME(c.user_type_id) AS type_name, c.is_nullable FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=kc.parent_object_id AND ic.index_id=kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE kc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona') AND kc.type='PK' ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal;

queries.name: writer_capability_sanity
queries.sql: SELECT HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios','OBJECT','ALTER') AS can_alter_socios, HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME(N'dbo.Gobierno_Persona','OBJECT','REFERENCES') AS can_reference_persona, IS_MEMBER('db_owner') AS is_db_owner, IS_MEMBER('db_ddladmin') AS is_db_ddladmin;
